hold_text: Tier-3 order path. The diff changes what instruction reaches the venue on an Alpaca close: src/units/accounts/execute.py is named in this guard's own TIER3_PATHS, and src/units/accounts/alpaca_client.py is Tier-2 by the src/** rule. The approval sought is the operator's, and it is ALREADY GIVEN in substance — they were asked on 2026-09-08 whether to trade-scope the Alpaca close or rule whole-symbol close intended, and chose to trade-scope it. What is NOT approved and is being asked for on this PR is the one decision the approval left open: MI-173's operator question 3, strict vs reduction for the follow-on confirmation. The trade-scoped path here confirms on a REDUCTION, because a partial close can never satisfy a 'the symbol must disappear' gate and would otherwise report failure forever and retry, eating the sibling's position a slice at a time. The whole-symbol path's strict flat-confirm is untouched. Holding is also right because this must not land ahead of a human reading the MI-140 coupling: alpaca_live is real money and immune today only because it cannot place orders at all.
why: Trade-scopes the Alpaca close OPERATION and modify_protective, under WO-20260908-TRADE-SCOPE-THE-ALPACA-CLOSE-OPERATION-AND, from MI-173's measurement in #11312. execute.close_open_position validated a per-trade qty and then never passed it, and AlpacaClient.close had no qty parameter at all, so closing a 16-share journal row on a symbol the account was short 72 of liquidated all 72 and left the sibling row open with nothing behind it. The first step was a capability question, not a patch: DELETE /v2/positions/{symbol_or_asset_id} documents a qty query parameter ('the number of shares to liquidate. Can accept up to 9 decimal points. Cannot work with percentage'), so the venue CAN express the scoped operation and the operator's approval holds. Scope is resolved from one live position read taken before anything destructive: a trade that IS the whole position keeps the pre-existing whole-symbol path byte-for-byte, a trade smaller than the position takes a reduction that cancels nothing, and an unreadable position DEFERS rather than falling back to a flatten. modify_protective gains the same qty scoping and REFUSES rather than guessing when no leg matches or two same-size legs are indistinguishable. The success log no longer prints a per-trade qty next to a whole-symbol flatten. It does NOT extend #11279's confirmation change to Alpaca, does not remediate MI-140, and does not touch account capability gating or config. Ten new tests fail on main on behaviour; the population is stated in the test module's own docstring.
